facets.F1_correctness: The substrate DAG acyclicity gate now loads repo-specific DAG selection from policy data and validates policy gate_id plus repo-relative dag_path before reading the DAG.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 unit tests cover policy accept, wrong gate_id rejection, and path escape rejection; live gate tests verify the policy points at the canonical DAG and the DAG remains green.
facets.F3_maintainability: Repo-specific adoption data moved into substrate-dependency-dag-policy.json while the Rust engine remains focused on parsing, Tarjan cycle detection, Kahn ordering, and forbidden-edge validation.
facets.F4_compatibility: The binary default uses the new policy file, `--policy` allows another policy path, and existing `--dag` override remains available for direct diagnostic runs.
facets.F5_security: Policy dag_path validation rejects empty paths, absolute paths, prefixes, and parent-directory escapes before any file read.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant, user, customer, credential, or production data is introduced; the policy points at repository architecture metadata only.
facets.F7_operability: Operators can run the same gate with the default policy, an explicit policy file, or a direct DAG override; failure messages distinguish policy errors from DAG errors.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime scaling risk is added; policy parsing is one small JSON read before the existing DAG validation pass.
facets.F9_compliance: No generated JSON faces are hand-edited. The new policy data file is justified through ADR-0280 and verified through the cloud-ci firewall total-accounting gate.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a git revert of one cloud-ci gate change, one policy data file, one ADR accounting line, and this evidence file; no production state or data migration is involved.
facets.F11_observability: Binary output remains the existing GREEN/RED substrate DAG validation message; policy and DAG parse errors are separated for diagnosis.
facets.F13_migration: This moves the cloud-ci gate toward a universal Rust API/data-pack boundary by separating reusable validation logic from repo-specific DAG selection data.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected a broader cloud-ci framework extraction and instead made the narrowest data-pack seam around the hardcoded DAG path.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: The slice advances Lane 3 M2 without touching workflows, oya-ci.toml, lane-4 generated materializers, or generated outputs.
